hook.name: PrismReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: Collects a 1.2% fee on buys (in native ETH, accumulated into a reflection pot) and on sells (in tokens, sent immediately to the token contract via notifyReflection()). Every 20 swaps, a buyback is queued; execution requires a manual call to buyAndReflectPrism(), which spends the ETH pot to buy back the pool token via poolManager.swap() and distributes it via notifyReflection(). Sells in the same block as a buyback revert; exact-output swaps are unsupported.
